title: Projects and project membership
summary: Current project directory, lifecycle, read permissions, membership administration and eligible-person discovery. Workflow and board configuration have separate canonical areas.

cases.title: List accessible projects
preconditions: The actor is an active approved account with the role stated in the case; project-scoped cases have a current accessible project unless the denial scenario says otherwise.
steps: Open Projects while signed in.
expected: Only accessible project metadata and the caller effective role are shown.

notes: Surface correction: browser interaction assertions remain on this stable ID. The distinct service contract is tracked by UC-PRJ-0066.

cases.title: Deny archived membership writes to project administrator
preconditions: The actor is a project administrator without company administrator status in an archived project.
steps: Attempt to save or remove a membership through the API or MCP.
expected: The shared transaction guard returns Archived projects are read-only; AllowArchived alone does not permit this actor to write.
notes: This is a confirmed permission boundary, not a browser/backend permission mismatch.

cases.title: Reject surrounding project-key whitespace at the public contract
preconditions: The actor is an active approved account with the role stated in the case; project-scoped cases have a current accessible project unless the denial scenario says otherwise.
steps: Submit a project key with leading or trailing whitespace through REST or MCP.
expected: The published key pattern rejects the request; no project is created.
notes: Source review and isolated Playwright integration confirmed that public schema validation runs before service trimming.
